raw: Agent Name: WebSurfer, Step Number: 16, Reason for Mistake: Claimed a Treccani/Enciclopedia Italiana source stated Lorenzo Costa the Younger died in 1585 without actually extracting or citing that text from the opened page (which they hadn’t scrolled/read). This unsupported, contradictory claim (common references list 1583) was a hallucination that introduced the wrong death year and misled the solution.
